text:
Nora (Marketing): Final pass on the webinar playbook please 5-min session: topic = "Practical inference economics: benchmarks & fallbacks". Need short abstract, two headline variants, run-of-show, rehearsals, and lead routing. Can we close by EOD?
Diego (Product): I'll own demo content + technical slide of routing/fallbacks. Plan live demo + hot-swap video.
Jules (Demand): I'll pull the target list (PMs, infra leads) and a one-slide benchmark highlight for the thank-you PDF. Also propose gated benchmark download on TY page.
Sam (Ops): I'll set up the backstage doc and practice switching to video. ops-bot: "Reminder: assign ops lead for demo switch"
Nora (Marketing): Abstract draft (short): "How teams reduce per-token costs and keep latency predictable when serving LLMs in production. Benchmarks, tradeoffs, and runbook for safe rollouts." Feedback?
Jules (Demand): Good. Add a line about quantization + caching wins in real workloads.
Diego (Product): Suggest we add "real numbers from customer X (anonymized)" in the benchmark slide, that convinces engineers.
Nora (Marketing): Headline A (product): "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower per-token spend". Headline B (technical): "Behind the scenes: batching, KV cache, and fallback policies that save tokens". Which to use for dev communities?
Jules (Demand): Use B for dev lists, A for PM/product newsletters. We'll A/B the subject line.
Sam (Ops): Rehearsal windows: Wed 10am PT (dry run 15m), Mon 2pm PT (full run). Which works?
Diego (Product): Mon 2pm PT is better for engineers. I'll be available.
Nora (Marketing): Ok lock Mon 2pm PT rehearsal. I'll schedule invites.
Sam (Ops): Run-of-show proposal (45m):
Sam (Ops): ```
00:00-02:00 Welcome & logistics (Nora)
02:00-08:00 Abstract & TL;DR (Nora)
08:00-25:00 Live demo + architecture (Diego)
25:00-33:00 Benchmark narrative + customer stat (Jules)
33:00-40:00 Panel Q&A (all)
40:00-45:00 CTA, downloads, poll (Nora/Jules)
```
Diego (Product): Can we trim demo to 15m and push more time to Q&A? Engineers ask deep q's.
Nora (Marketing): Fine 5-min split adjusted: demo 15m, benchmarks 10m, Q&A 15m, outro 5m.
Jules (Demand): Poll idea during outro: "Which serving cost drives you most nuts?" options: cold starts, tail latency, token spend, billing surprises. We'll use poll results in SDR playbook.
Diego (Product): Demo fallback checklist: 1) if auth fails, switch to video; 2) if latency > 800ms 3 checks in 2min, abort live; 3) use pinned local model if network degraded. ops-bot: "Runbook snippet added to backstage doc"
Sam (Ops): I'll be switch operator. Hotkey script: `./switch-demo --mode recorded --file demo-fallback.mp4` -- rehearsed.
Nora (Marketing): Lead routing: immediate -> demo-registrants list + tag utm=webinar_infer_econ; fallback -> nurture list with benchmark PDF gated. Jules will own mapping.
Jules (Demand): Confirmed. Also prepping a 1-page benchmark PDF and CSV of sample UTM-tagged links.
Diego (Product): Slides: avoid explicit model brand names. Use friendly labels (Model X, Model Y) on cost chart. Also include a tiny caption about quantization levels used.
Nora (Marketing): Registration copy variant for dev list: short blurb + benefit bullets. I'll post two variants in the doc and run A/B.
Sam (Ops): AV checklist for rehearsal: camera, mic, test recorded video playback, share screen permissions, remove system notifications.
Nora (Marketing): Action items: Nora 5-min landing copy + 2 headlines; Diego demo + fallback video; Jules benchmark PDF + UTM links; Sam backstage doc + hotkey scripts + calendar invites. Everyone EOD?
Diego (Product): EOD for demo assets.
Jules (Demand): EOD for benchmark materials.
Sam (Ops): I'll create invites now. ops-bot: "Event created: Webinar Rehearsal Mon 2pm PT"
Nora (Marketing): One more: social promo plan  schedule 3 tweets + 1 short LinkedIn post. Use the technical headline for dev Twitter.
Jules (Demand): I'll draft the LinkedIn post and tag customers (anonymized) for credibility.
Nora (Marketing): Great. I'll collate everything into the final playbook and post in #marketing before bedtime. Thanks all :sparkles:
